  --variant {resnet18}  Pilot model variant (default: resnet18).

                        One-label-per-line ImageNet labels file.

                        Runtime BPU core indexes (default: 0).
  --img-save-path IMG_SAVE_PATH
                        Optional path for a simple annotated result image.
  --list-models         List manifest-backed pilot asset references without
                        board access.
  --dry-run             Resolve/check a selection without loading a model or
                        SDK.

usage: main.py [-h] [--target {auto,x5,s100,s100p,s600}]
               [--det-asset-id DET_ASSET_ID] [--rec-asset-id REC_ASSET_ID]
               [--det-model-path DET_MODEL_PATH]
               [--rec-model-path REC_MODEL_PATH]
               [--vocabulary-path VOCABULARY_PATH] [--test-img TEST_IMG]
               [--output-format {text,json}] [--json-output JSON_OUTPUT]
               [--priority PRIORITY] [--bpu-cores BPU_CORES [BPU_CORES ...]]
               [--model-dir MODEL_DIR] [--list-models | --dry-run | --prepare]

Audited two-stage PaddleOCR inference on RDK X5 or S100.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --target {auto,x5,s100,s100p,s600}
                        Target selection: auto, x5, s100, s100p, or s600.
  --det-asset-id DET_ASSET_ID
                        Qualified detector manifest reference
                        group:sample:filename.
  --rec-asset-id REC_ASSET_ID
                        Qualified recognizer manifest reference
                        group:sample:filename.
  --det-model-path DET_MODEL_PATH
                        Existing local detector artifact; never downloaded
                        implicitly.
  --rec-model-path REC_MODEL_PATH
                        Existing local recognizer artifact; never downloaded
                        implicitly.
  --vocabulary-path VOCABULARY_PATH
                        Optional checked-in S100 UTF-8 dictionary replacement
                        (hash checked).
  --test-img TEST_IMG   BGR input image path (defaults to the selected sample
                        fixture).
  --output-format {text,json}
                        Inference/report output format (default: text).
  --json-output JSON_OUTPUT
                        Also write the JSON inference result to this local
                        path.
  --priority PRIORITY   Runtime scheduling priority, 0 through 255 (default:
                        0).
  --bpu-cores BPU_CORES [BPU_CORES ...]
                        Runtime BPU core indexes (default: 0).
  --model-dir MODEL_DIR
                        Destination directory for the explicit --prepare
                        operation.
  --list-models         List finite manifest-backed detector/recognizer pairs.
  --dry-run             Resolve a pair and print its static contract without
                        SDK access.
  --prepare             Explicitly fetch selected manifest assets into local
                        paths.

Manifest-backed PaddleOCR pilot pair references:

usage: main.py [-h] [--platform {auto,x5,s100,s100p,s600}]
               [--task {detect,seg,pose,cls,obb}] [--family FAMILY]
               [--model-size MODEL_SIZE] [--model-path MODEL_PATH]
               [--asset-id ASSET_ID] [--input-shape INPUT_SHAPE]
               [--test-img TEST_IMG] [--label-file LABEL_FILE]
               [--img-save-path IMG_SAVE_PATH] [--score-thres SCORE_THRES]
               [--nms-thres NMS_THRES] [--resize-type {0,1}]
               [--classes-num CLASSES_NUM] [--strides STRIDES] [--mc MC]
               [--angle-sign ANGLE_SIGN] [--angle-offset ANGLE_OFFSET]
               [--regularize {0,1}] [--reg REG] [--nkpt NKPT] [--topk TOPK]
               [--kpt-conf-thres KPT_CONF_THRES] [--priority PRIORITY]
               [--bpu-cores BPU_CORES [BPU_CORES ...]] [--list-models]
               [--dry-run] [--download]

Ultralytics YOLO unified inference

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --platform, --target {auto,x5,s100,s100p,s600}
                        Target platform. When omitted, the board is detected
                        from /sys/class/boardinfo. Preparation may select any
                        target; inference requires matching local board
                        identity. (default: None)
  --task {detect,seg,pose,cls,obb}
                        Task type. (default: detect)
  --family FAMILY       Model family, for example yolo11, yolov8, yolov10 or
                        yolov5u. (default: None)
  --model-size MODEL_SIZE
                        Model scale, for example n, s, m, l, x. Defaults to
                        the family default of the platform. (default: None)
  --model-path MODEL_PATH
                        Path to a compiled model. Overrides the resolved
                        default path and is never downloaded. (default: None)
  --asset-id ASSET_ID   Exact existing manifest reference
                        group:sample:filename; use --list-models to inspect
                        references. (default: None)
  --input-shape INPUT_SHAPE
                        Explicit model input geometry as HxW, used only when
                        the runtime does not report it. (default: None)
  --test-img TEST_IMG   Path to the test image. (default: D:\20_Dev_Projects\2
                        1_RDK_MODEL_ZOO\rdk_model_zooo_mccc\_worktrees\catalog
                        -sample-audit\samples\vision\ultralytics_yolo\test_dat
                        a\bus.jpg)
  --label-file LABEL_FILE
                        Path to a label file. Defaults to the sample COCO
                        labels for detect/seg/pose and the sample ImageNet
                        labels for cls. (default: None)
  --img-save-path IMG_SAVE_PATH
                        Path to save the rendered result image. (default:
                        result.jpg)
  --score-thres SCORE_THRES
                        Confidence score threshold. (default: 0.25)
  --nms-thres NMS_THRES
                        IoU threshold for NMS. Defaults to the value the
                        selected platform documents. (default: None)
  --resize-type {0,1}   Resize policy: 0 stretch, 1 letterbox. Defaults to the
                        value the selected platform documents. (default: None)
  --classes-num CLASSES_NUM
  --strides STRIDES
  --mc MC
  --angle-sign ANGLE_SIGN
  --angle-offset ANGLE_OFFSET
                        OBB offset in degrees (default: 0.0)
  --regularize {0,1}
  --reg REG             Number of DFL regression bins. (default: 16)
  --nkpt NKPT           [Pose] Number of keypoints. (default: 17)
  --topk TOPK           [Cls] Top-K classification results. (default: 5)
  --kpt-conf-thres KPT_CONF_THRES
                        [Pose] Keypoint visibility threshold. (default: 0.5)
  --priority PRIORITY   Model priority (0~255). 0 is lowest, 255 highest.
                        (default: 0)
  --bpu-cores BPU_CORES [BPU_CORES ...]
                        BPU core indexes to run inference on. (default: [0])
  --list-models         List the model assets the selected platform publishes,
                        then exit. Needs no board runtime. (default: False)
  --dry-run             Print the resolved model path and download URL, then
                        exit without downloading or running. Needs no board
                        runtime. (default: False)
  --download            Download the resolved model if it is missing, then
                        exit without running inference. (default: False)
